transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. I'm here to help. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Hi Dr. Smith. I've been having a really hard time with my attention and focus lately. I struggle to organize my tasks and often fail to follow through on instructions or finish my work.
Have you struggled with these difficulties with focus and organization since you were a child, or is this a more recent change in your life?

I've actually struggled with these focus and organization issues since I was a kid, definitely starting before I turned 12. While it's always been there in the background, it has become a really persistent, noticeable problem for me over the last year and three months.
Beyond the issues with focus and organization, do you also find yourself frequently fidgeting, struggling to stay seated, or acting impulsively without thinking of the consequences?

No, I don't really experience those kinds of issues. I've never really had trouble with fidgeting or staying seated, and my struggles are mainly limited to the focus and organization problems I mentioned.

latest_inference.note: The patient explicitly denied symptoms of hyperactivity and impulsivity (fidgeting, staying seated, acting without thinking). Given the longstanding history starting in childhood and the focus on inattentive symptoms, the Combined and Hyperactive/Impulsive presentations are now excluded, leaving only the Predominantly Inattentive Presentation.
